d:
Celebrate with the timeless classic 'Ek Bata Do Do Bate Char' from the movie Kalicharan, featuring the iconic Shatrughan Sinha. Let's pay tribute to our dedicated educators with this heartwarming song by Anuradha Paudwal and Kanchan.
Song Details :
Song: Ek Bata Do Do Bate Char
Singers t: Anuradha Paudwal, Kanchan
Music Director: Kalyanji-Anandji
Lyricist: Inderjit Singh Tulsi
Movie Details
Cast : Shatrughan Sinha, Reena Roy, Premnath, Ajit, Madan Puri
